lessons.title: Disaster safety tips
lessons.kind: 对话 · Mr Green 与同学们讨论自然灾害中的安全做法

lines.text: Class, what do you know about natural disasters like earthquakes, typhoons, floods, and wildfires?
They are very powerful and dangerous.
That’s right. When it comes to earthquakes, what should people do to stay safe?
If an earthquake happens, we should stay calm and quickly find shelter to protect ourselves from falling objects.
Great advice! And what about typhoons? How can we prepare for them?
For typhoons, we should stay indoors, away from windows and from any dangerous objects outside. We should shut all windows and doors.
Good points. Now, let’s talk about floods. What actions should we take during a flood?
We should go to higher ground. Never try to walk or drive through flood waters. They can be dangerous.

lessons.title: Staying safe in an earthquake
lessons.kind: 说明文 · 地震发生时室内外的避险方法

lines.text: Earthquakes can occur anytime without warning. So it is important to be prepared and know how to protect yourself.
What should you do if one happens? Stay calm as the earth begins to shake.
If you are inside when the earthquake starts, get under a table or a bed. You need to have something strong around you to protect you from falling objects.
Do not stand near walls or windows. Stay out of the kitchen. Also, never get into a lift during an earthquake.
If you are outside, get to an open area as fast as you can. Stay away from buildings and trees.
If you are in a vehicle, pull over to a place far from trees or tall buildings and stay in the car.
If you are close to the sea, try to get as far away from the water as possible.
Earthquakes can cause huge, dangerous waves that appear rapidly.
When the earthquake is over, there is still plenty of danger. If you see a fire, quickly move outdoors to an open area.
Keep an eye out for things that can fall on you. Only make necessary phone calls. Too many calls will bring down the phone system.
Staying calm can improve your chances of survival in an earthquake. It is not easy, but it can save your life.

lessons.title: Secondary disasters
lessons.kind: 说明文 · 以日本福岛地震为例说明次生灾害

lines.text: Disasters are terrible. Sometimes, secondary disasters are even more dangerous because they create more damages.
Secondary disasters include landslides, fires, floods, and so on. Here is a serious example.
On March 11, 2011, the largest earthquake ever recorded in Japan caused great destruction. Tsunami waves hit the coastal area less than half an hour later.
They also destroyed the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plant. In the following days, explosions rocked the plant.
More than 150,000 people had to leave the area. Lots of radioactivity got into the ocean and came down from the atmosphere.
In August, 2023, the Japanese government began to release the radioactive water from the Fukushima plant into the ocean.
The water could have a deep impact on sea life and the environment. People living in coastal areas around the world are worried.
The radioactive water from the plant is still considered harmful today.
The earthquake highlighted an important problem — disasters often cause a chain reaction, leading to more problems.
If people do not deal with them properly, it will lead to greater disasters.
It is everyone’s responsibility to take action to reduce disasters or secondary disasters.

lessons.title: Natural disasters are dangerous!
lessons.kind: 说明文 · 台风、野火与洪水的危害

lines.text: Typhoons are strong storms with powerful winds. They usually occur in the Western North Pacific.
Typhoons form when warm water from the ocean meets special wind patterns. Typhoons can bring heavy rain and help cool down hot summers.
However, they can be very dangerous and cause a lot of damage. During a typhoon, wind speeds can reach up to 252 kilometres per hour or even higher.
This can lead to trees falling, buildings getting damaged, and some areas flooding.
Wildfires are big, out-of-control fires. They happen in natural places like forests and grasslands.
They can badly hurt animals, plants, and the environment. They are also dangerous to people living nearby.
In 2023, Canada experienced many big forest fires, affecting an area of over 60,000 square kilometres.
Floods are huge amounts of water covering an area. They happen when there’s too much rain or when rivers overflow.
Floods can hurt a lot of people and destroy farms, buildings, and roads.
In China, one of the biggest floods was the 1998 Changjiang River flood. The PLA troops fought against this terrible flood and protected millions of people from drowning.
They successfully kept major cities like Wuhan safe.

lessons.title: Let’s do an escape drill!
lessons.kind: 记叙文 · 雅安地震中的七秒撤离与逃生要点

lines.text: On June 1, 2013, an earthquake hit Ya’an, Sichuan Province. When the building began to shake, a teacher at Fengcun School shouted to his students, “Earthquake! Run!”
He opened the door at the same time. All the students bent down, covered their heads with their hands, and quickly left the building from the front door in order.
Amazingly, they all made it safely within just seven seconds, without any injuries.
From this incident, we can learn much about how to respond in times of danger.
Overcome your fears and act quickly. The moment you feel the disaster coming, you should act without thinking twice.
Work with others. Teamwork increases survival chances. In times of disaster, the best survival strategy for people is usually to follow the group.
Do escape drills. Disasters can happen at any time. Practice often so you don’t have to stop to think during a real emergency.
Remember: survival = calm + will to survive + knowledge of escape

lessons.title: Measures to prevent floods
lessons.kind: 说明文 · 中国三峡大坝与英国泰晤士河防洪闸

lines.text: Floods are common natural disasters. They can cause serious damage to homes and crops, and pose a threat to human lives.
Many countries take all kinds of measures to prevent floods based on their specific conditions.
The Three Gorges Dam plays a crucial role in preventing floods in China.
This dam is located on the Changjiang River and helps control the flow of water during heavy rains.
The dam acts as a barrier to hold back excess water and releases it slowly and safely.
This makes sure that the areas nearby are protected from the floods.
By controlling the water levels, the dam keeps people safe.
The Thames Barrier is an important flood defense system in the UK.
It is located on the River Thames with huge gates that can be raised during high tides to protect London from flooding.
The barrier has successfully prevented many floods since its completion in 1982, safeguarding the city and its people.
